name: Alphiel
source:
The only half-elf to exist in Carandol. 
She was born with the power of the Goddess of Light and was ordained to be the Priestess, destined to vanquish Ordairth. After her great battle, she was transported to the Mordred world.
translation:
The only half-elf to exist in Carandol. 
She was born with the power of the Goddess of Light and was ordained to be the Priestess, destined to vanquish Ordairth. After her great battle, she was transported to the Mordred world.
